The `Foundations · Cards` page is built in Figma and its 1920 component, `Page · Foundations · Cards`, is made. The report is [kit/cards.md](cards.md), committed. I looked at screenshots of each section but did not check the whole page at 100%.

- **Sections:** it covers all six sections the brief asked for. They are each card style at 280, 400 and 520, density, grids, card on card, colour on dark, and notes.
- **Master changes:** Plain, Stat and Feature are now sets with a Compact density, which pads with the `gap` token (16). The empty content slot no longer holds 100 px of blank. Long header titles now stop after two lines.
- **Not linked yet:** the page is not linked from `Index · full size` or the Overview card, the same gap Essentials still has.
- **Task log:** `cards/task.jsonl` has only the opening line the launcher wrote. I did not log steps as I went, and I did not post an `owner_note`.
